tools.name: x402_pay_guard
tools.description: Free. Use right before paying an x402 seller: screens the payTo wallet against the OFAC list, checks that payTo is a wallet this seller lists in the x402 Bazaar or Circle catalogue (catches a swapped or injected payTo), looks up the seller's payer history, age and uptime, and checks the amount again

tools.name: watch_alerts
tools.description: Free. Use at the start of a session or on a schedule when the user has Factline watches (from watch_30_days or a key): lists the watches and any alerts (a new sanctions match, a company status, name or address change, APK or recall change). Input: token (wt_..., returned by watch_30_days) or api_key

tools.name: get_trial_key
tools.description: Free. Use when Factline's free calls for today are used up or the user wants more paid checks without a crypto wallet. Without an email it returns a starter key at once (100 credits, 14 days, no human step). With the user's work email it returns a trial key (2,000 credits a month, one per email); se

tools.name: eu_exchange_rates
tools.description: Free. Use when the user needs an official euro exchange rate or a conversion for an invoice, contract or report: ECB euro reference rates (about 30 currencies), today or any working day in the last 90 days, with cross rates. Input: base (default EUR), symbols (e.g. USD,GBP), optional date YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: eu_law_lookup
tools.description: Free. Use when the user cites an EU regulation, directive or decision and you need its official title, date, whether it is still in force, and the EUR-Lex link to cite: by CELEX number (e.g. 32016R0679) or citation (e.g. Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Directive 2015/849).

tools.name: webshop_check
tools.description: Free. Use before a shopping agent or the user pays an unfamiliar webshop: domain age, company and VAT number on the site (VAT checked in VIES), contact page, payment methods, prepayment-only or crypto-only, 70-99% discount lures. Returns looks_ok, caution or avoid and decision allow, review or deny.

tools.name: firm_check
tools.description: Free. Use when the user asks whether criminals can send mail as their firm or whether lookalike domains of it exist: DMARC and SPF status of the firm's domain and registered lookalike domains (typos, swapped letters). Input: domain.

tools.name: supplier_card_verify

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "kyc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_pay_guard, get_trial_key, webshop_check, mcp_server_check, payment_run_check · Private data: x402_pay_guard, watch_alerts, get_trial_key, webshop_check, payment_run_check, eudr_geo_check · Public sink: get_trial_key, firm_check, mcp_server_check · Destructive: mcp_server_check, payment_run_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_pay_guard, get_trial_key, webshop_check, mcp_server_check, payment_run_check · Private data: x402_pay_guard, watch_alerts, get_trial_key, webshop_check, payment_run_check, eudr_geo_check · Public sink: get_trial_key, firm_check, mcp_server_check · Destructive: mcp_server_check, payment_run_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
